subject: general
question: The Great Bath is located at:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mohenjo-daro**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Great Bath** is one of the most significant architectural structures found at **Mohenjo-daro**, an important site of the **Indus Valley Civilization**.
 
• It is believed to have been used for **ritualistic or religious bathing**, showcasing the advanced planning and social systems of the civilization.
 
• The structure is made of **bricks, gypsum mortar, and bitumen**, which was used for waterproofing.
 
• The bath measures approximately **12 meters long, 7 meters wide, and 2.4 meters deep**, with steps leading into the pool.
 
• The presence of **drainage systems** and a nearby well highlights the advanced engineering and water management practices of the era.
 
• **Mohenjo-daro** is located in present-day **Pakistan**, in the province of Sindh, and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• The Great Bath indicates the civilization's emphasis on **cleanliness, hygiene, and possibly religious practices.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Harappa**__

 __
 
• **Harappa** is another major site of the **Indus Valley Civilization**, located in present-day **Punjab, Pakistan.**
 
• It is known for its **granaries**, urban planning, and artifacts like seals and pottery.
 
• Unlike Mohenjo-daro, no structure resembling the Great Bath has been discovered at Harappa.
 
 
 
• **Dholavira**__
 __
 
• **Dholavira** is located in the **Kutch district of Gujarat, India**, and was a prominent city of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• It is known for its **water conservation systems**, reservoirs, and unique urban planning.
 
• No evidence of a structure similar to the Great Bath has been found at Dholavira.
 
 
 
• **Rakhigarhi**__
 
 
• **Rakhigarhi** is situated in the state of **Haryana, India**, and is one of the largest sites of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• It is known for its **burials, pottery, and seals**.
 
• No structure resembling the Great Bath has been discovered at Rakhigarhi.
